verdict.rationale: Zero is an inbox product, and email inbox products can plausibly add other customer channels, so this axis applies. However, all evidence describes email only: the Unified Inbox connects multiple email providers such as Gmail and Outlook, and the MCP capabilities cover email threads, drafts and labels. Nothing mentions SMS, WhatsApp, social or live-chat channels.

support.subject: As a team-lead, the same inbox also handles adjacent customer channels — SMS, WhatsApp, social, or live chat — beside email
